Title: Zéjel (Armonía)

In the depths of my soul's echo,
A harmonious melody resonates, (aa)

In the tapestry woven by thoughts, (bb)
Where shadows dance in the twilight hue, (bb)
A symphony softly sings and weaves. (bb)

The rhythm of life's sweet refrain, (ccc)
A harmony that soothes the pain, (ccc)
In every moment, a new strain. (ccc)

Armonía, in you I find, (ccc)
A peace, a song, a gentle bind, (ccc)
That mends life's broken chord. (ccc)
